name: cipherbird
description: CipherBird for Node.js: hashing, authenticated encryption, public-key cryptography, post-quantum algorithms (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, X-Wing), hybrid key agreement, sealed messaging, Noise, HPKE, OPAQUE, BBS, FROST, vaults, a keyring, media entropy and steganography from one bundled native engine. The same API as the cipherbird Dart packages.
